test_rasp_program_and_craft_model_produc: test that RASP programs and compiled craft models produce the same output for map, sequence_map, and select_aggregate operations
test_compiled_models_produce_expected_ou: test compiled craft models against predefined test cases from test_cases module to verify expected outputs
test_setting_default_values_can_lead_to_: test that setting default values in aggregate can cause wrong outputs in compiled models due to BOS token interference

embed_input_sequence: embed an input sequence into stacked vectors using token, index, BOS, and ONE basis directions
